en: Improved the status shown in Remote Control, claude.ai and the desktop app for a session waiting on a permission prompt to name an MCP tool by its server and readable name instead of its `mcp__server__tool` identifier
zh: 改进 Remote Control、claude.ai 和桌面应用中，session 等待权限提示时显示的状态：MCP 工具改为按 server 和可读名称显示，而不再显示其 `mcp__server__tool` 标识符
